scripts.db:migrate:new: echo 'Run against Supabase: cross-env DATABASE_URL=<supabase_url> prisma migrate dev --name'
scripts.test: tsx tests/budget-math.mjs && tsx tests/fuzz-budget.mjs && tsx tests/bid-matrix-logic.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync(require.resolve('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs'),'public/pdf.worker.min.mjs');console.log('✓ pdf.worker.min.mjs copied to public/')}catch(e){console.warn('pdf worker copy failed:',e.message)}"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync(require.resolve('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs'),'public/pdf.worker.min.mjs');console.log('✓ pdf.worker.min.mjs copied to public/')}catch(e){console.warn('pdf worker copy failed:',e.message)}" && node scripts/check-dynamic-pages.js && node scripts/check-migrations-postgres.js && node scripts/check-schema-migrations-sync.js
scripts.verify:units: node --test scripts/tests/intake.test.mjs scripts/tests/drawingExtract.test.mjs scripts/tests/siteVision.test.mjs scripts/tests/redact.test.mjs scripts/tests/ontology.test.mjs scripts/tests/agentClient.test.mjs scripts/tests/untrusted.test.mjs scripts/tests/adminMetrics.test.mjs
